lessons: Never repeat the video title in the first line—doing so in the Potato video caused an immediate 31.9% drop at 0.09s.
Avoid interactive delays like 'Pause and guess' or countdowns, which lost 15.2% of viewers in the Foil video and 8.3% in the Maple Syrup video.
Cut filler transitions and obvious statements; saying 'They look like similar fruits' dropped retention by 30.0% in the Fruits video.
Lead hooks with mind-bending comparative facts or extreme scale contrasts, which pushed 10% retention above 1.85 (e.g., Greenland Shark and Kuiper Belt videos).
Deliver immediate answers instead of lengthy situational setups, as painting scenarios like 'You just smashed your elbow' lost 23.4% of viewers early on.
worst_moment_types: Verbatim title repetition at the start
Slow narrative setups before reaching the core scientific premise
best_hook_types: Historical/scale benchmark comparisons ('older than the United States')
Direct biological contrast hooks ('meat looks like two completely different animals')
Challenging common scientific misconceptions ('Pluto seemed like our solar system's edge')
